title: Comparable Elements in Integer Lattices
exact_target: Can one save a fixed power below the quadratic bound for sets of triples in which every pair has two coordinate differences of the same strict sign?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 142 (GREEN-054). CC BY 4.0.
